svg.title: C4 Level 2 — Containers: residential-proxy egress for scrape-news-curator

g.text: C4 Level 2 — Containers: residential-proxy egress for scrape-news-curator
Lambda routes outbound traffic through the user's laptop's residential ISP IP via Tailscale, sidestepping Reddit's datacenter-IP block.
